bindingGeneration.description: Cross-center binding generation. This persists across same-center reconnects and certificate renewal; it is not a connection epoch.

mustChangePassword.description: True until the seeded bootstrap administrator rotates admin/admin.

nmChange.description: Typed joint NM/firewall proposal (sourceDigest + confirmSeconds + typed changes + optional automatic NAT set). Only nm.prepare accepts it.

nmAction.description: Original NM operation UUID plus the confirmation token. Only nm.confirm/nm.rollback accept it.

CreateTask.description: network.prepare requires networkChange; network.confirm/rollback/transaction require networkAction. Other operations reject these fields. Writes require admin. Task success reports execution of the request; inspect result.state for the independent network transaction outcome. Takeover plan/prepare require networkTakeover; takeover.prepare is admin-only. kura.configuration.get requires kuraConfiguration with pid and en/zh locale; all other operations reject that target. It is a read operation available to operator/admin. kura.configuration.update requires admin and kuraConfigurationUpdate, a current revision and typed set-only properties. Gateway capability must be enabled. Omitted fields and passwords stay unchanged. Unknown writes are never automatically replayed. kura.snapshot.save and kura.snapshot.rollback require admin, the matching typed payload, and gateway capability kura.snapshot.write. They do not rewind confirmed system network. Rollback is not a selective PID restore; components absent from the snapshot may return to defaults. Unknown snapshot actions are never automatically replayed. ordinary.boot.status/prepare/execute/cancel/reconcile require admin and fresh ordinary.boot.v1 capability. Only execute/cancel accept ordinaryBootAction. The gateway uses its fixed local grant; callers cannot supply command/unit/path. Status separates latest transaction and confirmed policy. Policy completion is not boot or business certification; UNKNOWN is never replayed. recovery.ordinary.status/prepare/execute require admin and fresh recovery.ordinary.v1 capability, disabled by default on the gateway. Prepare selects only the current locally committed completion and fixed profile. Execute and cancel accept ordinaryHandoffAction with the original handoff UUID and confirmation token. Cancellation additionally requires recovery.ordinary.cancel.v1, the live connection epoch and a 30-second deadline; older agents do not imply this support. It only abandons an unissued prepared handoff, preserves the approved parent and its original command evidence, and never clears RECOVERY_REQUIRED or invokes a unit. Expiry alone leaves an otherwise unchanged unissued plan prepared for explicit cancellation. Execution starts the fixed ordinary Kura once after stopping old recovery services; administrator-selected checks do not certify full recovery or reboot. Unknown requests are only queried and never replayed. service.status/restart.prepare/restart and system.reboot.prepare/reboot plus system.control.cancel require admin and fresh system.control.v1. Restart and host reboot require distinct local grants and advertised service.restart.v1/system.reboot.v1; all are off by default. Only restart, reboot and cancel accept systemControlAction. New writes are bound to the live connection epoch, with fixed 5-minute execution deadlines and 30-second other task deadlines. Stale unleased writes expire on reconnect; issued writes become UNKNOWN and are only queried. The agent controls the installation-fixed Kura unit and bounded cgroup; no caller shell/unit/path is accepted. Reboot acceptance is UNKNOWN until an actual changed boot identity is observed. Process transition and optional administrator-selected business checks are reported separately and never certify full Kura recovery. Cancellation only applies to unissued plans. Pending managed transactions and RECOVERY_REQUIRED block new writes. Firewall operations30-33 require admin and fresh firewall.remote.v1 capability. Only prepare accepts firewallChange, only confirm/rollback accept firewallAction. Writes are bound to the live connection epoch; unleased writes from an old connection expire, delivered writes remain UNKNOWN and are never requeued. Actual agent post-apply fresh authenticated connection is required for confirm. Prepare task success means applied WAIT_CONFIRM, not final confirmation. Query the original task after UNKNOWN. Input/result use existing encrypted storage. Non-admin task queries remove confirmationToken. Imported operations 38–48 use only importedFirewall and require the matching kind. Original actions and queries must belong to the same creator, gateway and binding generation. Imported queries verify the exact original and parent command hashes and immutable phase markers before resolving uncertainty; absent ACK/decision/history proof keeps UNKNOWN. A different committed phase marker resolves the unentered command as FAILED without redispatch. Confirmation requires an authenticated management connection established after the original forward ACK; the agent reconnects automatically, and the UI queries the original operation before enabling its countdown. A recovered confirm additionally requires its command-bound encrypted connection proof. Imported proposals retain source, revision, cohort and explicit destination prefixes.

NetworkTakeover.description: plan accepts only interface. prepare requires the reviewed expectedRevision/sourceDigest/planDigest and confirmation window 30–300 seconds.

pid.description: Nonblank PID, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.

editable.description: Reviewed component field whose min, max and options can be enforced. Uninterpretable constraints stay closed.

readOnlyReason.description: Present only when editable=false. Base metatype controls type, constraints and redaction; localization supplies presentation only.

valueShape.description: Effective value representation, including redacted or absent values. Capacity remains cardinality. Legacy Kura +/-1 scalar values are preserved; native OSGi +/-1 stays a bounded container.

KuraConfigurationProperty.description: Numeric values are decimal strings to preserve Java long precision. A redacted property has no value. Defaults and secret option lists are never exported. Non-secret option values are exported only so a reviewed component can be edited. This projection cannot identify arbitrary secrets embedded in user scripts.

updateEnabled.description: Explicit audited PID policy is enabled on the Kura bridge; independent agent and admin permission also required.

KuraConfigurationView.description: Successful operation 11 task result; bounded to 200 KiB by the local bridge. Online read through the OSGi ConfigurationService, independent of Kura Web credentials. This is not a generic configuration editor. directConfigAdminCas is always false: direct ConfigurationAdmin writers are not atomically locked.

KuraSnapshotSave.description: Saves the current Kura snapshot. expectedLatestId is 0 when none exist. Does not rewind confirmed system network.

KuraSnapshotRollback.description: Rolls back to an explicit older snapshot. Does not rewind confirmed system network. Components absent from that snapshot may return to defaults through the existing Kura rollback path.

currentPassword.description: Required for ordinary password changes; may be omitted only by an authenticated forced first-login setup session.

newPassword.description: 12..256 bytes; ends the forced first-login rotation.

clientCertificatePem.description: One externally signed PEM client leaf certificate.

caGeneration.description: Null indicates the original bootstrap CA.

signingManifestSha256.description: Original public CSR bundle digest for a signing handoff. Null for direct certificate enrollment.

clientKeyPem.description: Optional client private key (PEM). Scheme A provisioning: sealed once, returned only inside the one-time identity bundle, wiped at first download.

identityBundleToken.description: One-time identity bundle token; present only when the registration uploaded a client private key. Never shown again after delivery.

OrdinaryHandoffAction.description: Execute or explicitly cancel the previously reviewed fixed ordinary-profile handoff. No caller unit, path or command.

SystemControlAction.description: Original fixed-system plan and confirmation token. No target, path, command or reboot arguments are accepted.

NmChange.description: Typed joint NM/firewall proposal. The agent coordinator recompiles and validates under its shared writer boundary and authoritative 1.44+ version checks; the center never recompiles NM proposals.

sourceDigest.description: 64 lowercase hex digest of the two-pass NM source observation returned by nm.view.

confirmSeconds.description: NM checkpoint confirmation window in seconds; zero is never accepted (it would disable the version check guard).

changes.description: Typed changes JSON array (1..16 objects) in the preview grammar: interface plus optional ipv4/ipv6/ethernet patches. Legacy aliases of edited fields are removed by the agent.

nat.description: Optional automatic NAT set {wan,lan[]} with at most 16 downstream interfaces; omitted means no automatic NAT composition.

NmAction.description: Original NM operation UUID and the 32-hex confirmation token from the prepare receipt.

serverKey.description: Server private key PEM; stored in the pending area 0600, never echoed.

backupBase64.description: Base64 of the task-key backup file.

previousCertificateSha256.description: Current registered fingerprint; acts as an optimistic lock.

clientKeyPem.description: Optional new private key; when present a one-time rotation bundle is sealed for download.

operationId.description: Public canonical UUID saved before dispatch by new clients. Never resend an uncertain POST; query its original operation. Legacy omitted IDs are assigned by the server and cannot restore a previously lost client ID.

previousBindingGeneration.description: Explicit opt-in to the generation-aware renewal contract: this reviewed generation must match and is incremented by exactly one on APPLIED. Omitted pins retain legacy certificate-only rotation and do not change the binding generation.

confirmed.description: Must be true; rotation re-encrypts all task rows and resets in-flight streams.

FirewallCandidateV3.description: Complete V3 structured grammar. Total across all rule arrays <=256; first<=last; canonical serialized candidate <=16384 bytes. Agent performs address/interface/NAT compilation and system forwarding/ownership checks. No raw nft/iptables expressions.

FirewallCandidateV4.description: Exact legacy Kura ICMP semantics and explicit per-family OUTPUT policies. Same bounded structured rules; no raw expressions. Version3 retains its historical meaning.

ImportedFirewallRequest.description: Strict imported operation request. No owner key, confirmation token, UID, unit, path or native command is accepted. The center generates owner capabilities and stores them only inside encrypted task inputs. Original queries and pre-dispatch cancellation remain available without new write authorization. UNKNOWN never creates a replacement operation.

custodianIds.description: Null means all currently eligible administrators.

blockingOperationId.description: A missing original receipt blocks all later activation requests, including requests by another administrator.

blockingCsrRequestId.description: Original CSR staging has no valid receipt; manual staging and activation are blocked.

serverCsrId.description: Use an exactly matching SIGNED local CSR. serverKey must be empty or absent; the leaf key never leaves the server.

origin.description: Exact HTTPS center origin; the DNS name or IP is placed in the CSR SAN.

serverPem.description: Signed server leaf and optional public certificate chain. Never a CA private key.

operationId.description: New clients persist this non-nil per-upload identity and the PEM SHA-256 before dispatch. Omission preserves the legacy import contract; an unresolved original cannot be bypassed.

certificateRejected.description: Positive original validation rejection. New upload queries bind this decision to importOperation.operationId and certificateSha256; no missing receipt or current file state authorizes another upload.

installationOperationId.description: Original installation has an applied receipt bound to this exact leaf and local key. This is derived without changing installation records.

GatewayCertificateRotationReceipt.description: Original public operation result. UNKNOWN, including missing history, never settles from current gateway fingerprint. APPLIED must match the saved operation, gateway, previous/new fingerprints, public PEM hash and bundle mode. GET never returns or reissues a private bundle token. Historical APPLIED remains valid after later rotations. Version 2 records immutable previous/next generations. For version 2, certificate fingerprint, generation increment, connection reset and applied receipt commit together. Version 1 legacy operations preserve the generation and are not renewal authorizations. The public JSON file uses a strict allowlist and never includes a token or private key.

receiptVersion.description: Version 1 original receipts have no generation evidence. Existing rows are never backfilled from current gateway state.

previousBindingGeneration.description: Original reviewed generation for an explicit version 2 request. Null for historical and legacy certificate-only operations. REJECTED does not prove a credential change.

bindingGeneration.description: Version 2 proposed generation, exactly previous + 1. Only APPLIED proves it was committed. Null for old version 1 receipts or exhausted generation rejections.

GatewayCertificateRotationResponse.description: Original public operation result. UNKNOWN, including missing history, never settles from current gateway fingerprint. APPLIED must match the saved operation, gateway, previous/new fingerprints, public PEM hash and bundle mode. GET never returns or reissues a private bundle token. Historical APPLIED remains valid after later rotations. Version 2 records immutable previous/next generations. For version 2, certificate fingerprint, generation increment, connection reset and applied receipt commit together. Version 1 legacy operations preserve the generation and are not renewal authorizations. The public JSON file uses a strict allowlist and never includes a token or private key.

identityBundleToken.description: Original POST only; never available from receipt GET.

receiptVersion.description: Version 1 original receipts have no generation evidence. Existing rows are never backfilled from current gateway state.

previousBindingGeneration.description: Original reviewed generation for an explicit version 2 request. Null for historical and legacy certificate-only operations. REJECTED does not prove a credential change.

bindingGeneration.description: Version 2 proposed generation, exactly previous + 1. Only APPLIED proves it was committed. Null for old version 1 receipts or exhausted generation rejections.
